risk_flags.description: A bare list of codes could imply tally supports reporting or totals in all six currencies, while the requirements say totals and exports are always in USD. The contract should allow a short qualifier that these are accepted input currencies, not reporting denominations.
risk_flags.span: No exchange-rate information or conversion details added — listing only the currency codes

verdict.primary_risk: The contract may create misleading README wording by listing supported currencies without preserving the project requirement that reports and totals are denominated in USD.
